name: StrategicPartnerSwarm
objective: Implement a bounded strategic partner swarm runtime that creates role-specific advisory agents for planning, critique, validation and execution recommendations without granting autonomous mutation authority.
why_now: P23-P25 implemented repo probes, SDD/TDD mission planning and MissionOrchestrator DAG. P26 can now introduce a controlled swarm that reasons over physical evidence and mission DAGs instead of free-form chat memory.
must_not_create: external paid calls without explicit config
